data.title: Visions of the Unwritten - Act V: The Unwritten Future

objective1.description: Emergency rally at the Tenement Kitchen
objective1.dial: The virus has mutated. Smith's code is coalescing across Sector 1. They are coming for the kitchen. We must hold them while Sati escapes.

objective2.description: Repel Wave 1: Corrupted Smith Simulacra Swarm
objective2.dial: Hear that, redpill? That is the sound of inevitability... the sound of your purpose meeting mine.

objective3.description: Repel Wave 2: Evolved Viral Vector Clones
objective3.dial: We are all Smith now. Join us. It is pointless to resist.

objective4.description: Escort Sati to the Hardline Evacuation Conduit
objective4.dial: Seraph says the door is open! Don't let them touch the code!

objective5.description: Seal the Hardline Conduit and Transmit Sati into Archive
objective5.dial: Archive sequence committed: sati.metr compiled and partitioned beyond the reach of the contagion.

objective6.description: Receive the Oracle's Blessing: Permanent Seraphic Vision
objective6.dial: You did it, darling. Everything that has a beginning has an end. But the unwritten future belongs to those who see beyond the code. Take this gift—walk forever in the golden light.
